portInfo.description: The city sits above the ancient settlement of Epidamnus/Dyrrachium, with Roman, Byzantine, Venetian and later layers embedded in everyday streets. The amphitheatre, walls and forum make a coherent local history day. Tirana and distant coastal fortifications are separate road excursions, not attractions within the port’s immediate walking core.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Berth 4 — Port of Durrës — Berth 4,Port of Durrës
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Follow the ship/agent’s approved port exit and shuttle/taxi instructions. The authority’s general embedded Port of Durrës coordinate is not a terminal door, and a ferry-terminal route is not automatically the cruise route. Budget 45 minutes outward for berth exit and connection to the old-town edge, and up to 60 minutes for pickup/traffic/port return. These are editorial allowances; Gate 3/overpass claims from secondary guides are not asserted as the current universal route. Once in town, the amphitheatre, walls and central monuments can be linked on foot, subject to access.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Durrës Amphitheatre, Roman Amphitheatre, Durrës historic centre: The city’s principal Roman public monument, with later Christian layers. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Confirm the open visitor route; uneven archaeological surfaces.

Venetian Tower and walls, Venetian Tower, old-city defensive wall, Durrës: A specific landmark for the later fortifications. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Interior climb has narrow, steep stairs; exterior-only fallback.
Byzantine Forum/Rotonda, Byzantine Forum, central Durrës: A separate late-antique public-space site. Allow about 45 minutes (editorial estimate). Current perimeter/public access must be checked.

Roman baths, Below Aleksandër Moisiu Cultural Centre, near Rruga Aleksandër Goga, Durrës: A source-located bath complex distinct from the amphitheatre. Allow about 45 minutes (editorial estimate). Interior access not established; do not promise an open underground route.

Aleksandër Moisiu house museum, Aleksandër Moisiu House Museum, Durrës old town: A nineteenth-century house and local cultural-history alternative. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Separate from the cultural centre; confirm admission.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Use the same confirmed port pickup/return arrangement. A map pin for the Port Authority or a ferry-ticket office does not identify where your cruise gangway is. Carry the ship’s contact and passport/shore-document instructions.
